_comment: Edge smoothness floor, measured from the shipped weight maps. edgeRough is the staircase (higher is worse); edgeWidth is the transition in pixels. A build may not ship an edge rougher than these; width is held to an absolute 2.4 px rather than to the previous build, since a properly resolved boundary is both narrower and smoother. Set after the low-contrast veto was removed - the guided filter degrades to a local mean where the image has no colour to fit, which is the right answer, and handing those pixels back to the raw coverage was what painted the scene - taking the mean from 79.9 to 77.7 and bgPaint from 255 to 30. Edited deliberately, with crops compared, never to make a red build green.
